proposal.reason: Main change is CE/DMA-backed host one-sided RMA (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal), including new RMA CE launch/wait signaling protocol, task chunking, and CE resource lifecycle. enqueue is also needed because these APIs introduce a new planner task/plan path and launch/cleanup flow. communicator is needed for capability gating, config (`numRmaCtx`), init/finalize wiring, and communicator-level support flags. device-api is needed because the PR adds new public PCCL API surface and window/signal contract checks exposed through API/comm properties.
